_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: book_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

data.name: text_index
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (root_id, relative_path) REFERENCES local_files(root_id, relative_path) ON DELETE CASCADE

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("book_source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_names" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "custom_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "enabled_explore" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled_explore" IN (0, 1)), "last_update_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "raw" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_source_url"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'network', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, "source_book_url" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "custom_tag" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cover_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "custom_cover_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "intro" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "custom_intro" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "charset" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "latest_chapter_title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "latest_chapter_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_chapter_num" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "can_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("can_update" IN (0, 1)), "last_check_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_check_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "book_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "variable" TEXT NULL, "shelved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("shelved" IN (0, 1)), "root_id" TEXT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NULL, "format" TEXT NULL, "needs_relink" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_relink" IN (0, 1)), "raw" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "group_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "enable_refresh" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enable_refresh" IN (0, 1)), "show" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show" IN (0, 1)), "book_sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_groups" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "groups" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chapters" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "chapter_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variable" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "chapter_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_roots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "needs_relink" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_relink" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_files" ("root_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_roots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'txt', "text_length" INTEGER NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NULL, "needs_relink" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_relink" IN (0, 1)), "book_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("root_id", "relative_path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "text_index" ("root_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_roots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code_unit_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("root_id", "relative_path", "byte_offset"), FOREIGN KEY (root_id, relative_path) REFERENCES local_files(root_id, relative_path) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "progress" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "text_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "offset_in_line" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "text_length" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "chapter_key" TEXT NULL, "chapter_index" INTEGER NULL, "anchor" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "replace_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "replacement" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope" TEXT NULL, "exclude_scope" TEXT NULL, "scope_title" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("scope_title" IN (0, 1)), "scope_content" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("scope_content" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_regex" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_regex" IN (0, 1)), "timeout_millisecond" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rule_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "raw" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("book_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_cookies" ("domain" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "writer_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("domain", "name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_entries" ("source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("source_ref", "key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX books_natural_key ON books (source_ref, source_book_url)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX books_local_key ON books (root_id, relative_path)
CREATE INDEX books_shelf_order ON books (shelved, kind, book_order)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX groups_name ON "groups" (name)
CREATE INDEX book_groups_group ON book_groups (group_id, book_id)
CREATE INDEX chapters_toc_order ON chapters (book_id, chapter_index)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replace_rules_merge_key ON replace_rules (name, pattern, replacement)
CREATE INDEX replace_rules_order ON replace_rules (rule_order)
CREATE INDEX local_files_book ON local_files (book_id)
